name: skilljit
stderr:
Usage: skilljit [options] [command]

Just-in-time skill and MCP tool routing for Claude. Install thousands of skills
at the token cost of one — nothing loads into context until a task actually
needs it.

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  sync [options]                Refresh the local skill catalog from configured
                                GitHub sources
  search [options] <query>      Search the local skill catalog (no network, no
                                context cost)
  serve [options]               Run the skilljit MCP stdio server (this is what
                                your MCP client config should launch)
  stats [options]               Print current catalog size (token savings accrue
                                per-session inside a running MCP connection)
  init [options] <configPath>   Preview adopting an MCP client config (e.g.
                                claude_desktop_config.json) into skilljit —
                                never touches the original file
  adopt [options] <configPath>  Route servers in an MCP client config through
                                skilljit (backs up the original first)
  restore <configPath>          Undo `skilljit adopt` — restores the config from
                                its backup
  doctor [configPath]           Check that every upstream MCP server skilljit is
                                routing for a config still spawns and lists
                                tools
  incidents                     Capture and share debugging context across a
                                team
  help [command]                display help for command
